# One-offs

Every place app code was let off a rule, and why. Before writing an exception, look here for the same kind of
thing: a second copy of a one-off is a missing design-system component or variant, and belongs in src/ui/.

## raw-floating

_Floating surface: ui::floating / ui::floating_at. They occlude, so nothing under them takes the pointer._

- `src/activities.rs` — drawn in its own place; its elements take the pointer themselves
- `src/announcements.rs` — placed inside the overlay backdrop, which already occludes; the card occludes itself.
- `src/audio_player.rs` — rises from its bottom-left at the parent's position, which floating/floating_at can't express; the card occludes itself.
- `src/chat.rs` — hangs at absolute offsets from the field, not anchored; the card occludes itself.
- `src/drag.rs` — a drag ghost must not occlude the drop targets under it.
- `src/layout.rs` — a transparent full-window layer must not occlude; each overlay in it occludes itself
- `src/profile.rs` — placed inside the overlay backdrop, with a measured top margin floating_at can't take.
- `src/role_popout.rs` — placed inside the overlay backdrop, with a measured top margin floating_at can't take.
- `src/search_results.rs` — hangs at absolute offsets under the header, not anchored; the card occludes itself.
